name: mp4ff
reason: The upstream mp4ff 0.62.1 is a Go module with Go command-line tools, and its Homebrew formula installs those tools. No C or C++ library API is documented; the Go package is evaluated in the Go MP4 cell.

name: mp4box
reason: Homebrew mp4box resolves to the gpac formula and MP4Box is its CLI; the GPAC library package is counted once.

name: lieff/minimp4
reason: The upstream C MP4D_open callback API appears to parse local MP4 bytes and the repository had 441 GitHub stars on 2026-11-13, but upstream exposes no Git tag or GitHub release. No open-source release can be pinned under this protocol, so no control result is accepted. Stars are candidate interest only, not comparable to the Homebrew ranking metric.
